lines.text: A king prepares a wedding banquet for his son, but the invited guests refuse to come.
The king sends other servants to say the sheep and fattened cattle are killed and everything is ready.
Some guests ignore the invitation and others kill the servants, so the king sends troops to burn their city.
The king tells his servants to invite people from the crossroads, and the hall fills with evil and good guests.
The king finds a man without wedding clothes and orders him thrown into the fiery furnace.
